title: Stripe Financial Metrics and Payment Volume 2023-2024
content:
Observation: Stripe surpassed $1 trillion in total payment volume in 2023, up 25% year over year, showing that the company already operates at meaningful global scale.

Observation: Stripe is estimated to have generated about $14 billion in gross revenue in 2023, but net revenue is estimated at roughly $3.5 billion to $4 billion after network and banking pass-through costs. This gross-to-net gap matters because investors should focus on net revenue conversion and contribution margin rather than payment volume alone.

Observation: Stripe's core pricing remains anchored around 2.9% plus 30 cents per successful card charge, although larger enterprise customers negotiate custom economics. Implication: headline scale does not eliminate pricing pressure, especially as Stripe moves upmarket against better-capitalized peers.

Observation: Stripe serves millions of businesses and more than 100 enterprise customers that each process over $1 billion annually. Watch items: enterprise mix shift, durability of take rate, and whether software and financial-product attach can lift monetization beyond core payments.
